title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
description: Established tech business in Dubai seeking a hands-on Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead a 100-person tech organization, own technology strategy, scale platforms/teams, and drive enterprise AI transformation from concept to production. Requires 5+ years as a CTO (or equivalent) in an established business (regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, payments, or insurance preferred), track record of scaling teams/platforms, and practical AI adoption experience. Hybrid (2 days/week in Dubai office); full relocation to UAE required.

title: Senior Manager – Healthcare Business Analyst
description: Experienced leader to drive business analysis and digital transformation initiatives across the healthcare sector in Saudi Arabia. Requires 8+ years of relevant experience in healthcare business analysis, consulting, strategy, or transformation, strong Return on Investment (ROI) analysis expertise, and familiarity with AI tools.

title: Key Account Manager – Mid Market (Enterprise Vertical)
description: Key Account Manager for Mid Market Enterprise Vertical in Chennai handling 75 mid-market logos across Internet, Voice, and Cloud telecom solutions. Requires B2B field sales background in the telecom industry, experience in both farming and new business (National Account Managers handling large logos preferred), 3–4 daily client meetings (physical & virtual), multi-hierarchy/multi-function account engagement, age under 40, 6-day work week, and immediate availability.

title: Senior Integration Engineer
description: 1-year extendable remote contract for a Senior Integration Engineer on an enterprise project. Requires 5+ years of experience in Integration Engineering, designing and implementing integration solutions, hands-on expertise with APIs, middleware, system integration, integration patterns, REST/SOAP APIs, microservices, and troubleshooting/optimizing integration workflows.

title: Telecom Electrician
description: 12+ month Outside IR35 contract (£300/day, 5 days/week) for UK-based Telecom Electricians. Requires Gold Card standard with L3 Test & Inspect, 18th Edition, C&G 5357-03 or AM2, TEL001 DC Electrical Safety, EFAW, Manual Handling, Ladder Safety, and Asbestos Awareness. Experience in rack/infrastructure installation, DC power up to 95mm CSA, minor AC installs, router/server/Cat6/fibre installation, basic commissioning, transmission testing (BERT, RFC, Y1564), power surveys, and VMO2 Data Centres / BT Exchanges.

title: Project Manager – Substation Projects
description: Project Manager for 132/11kV, 220/11kV, and 400/132kV substation projects in Dubai, UAE (Salary: AED 22,000 – 28,000 + family benefits). Requires Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, 15–20 years overall industry experience (5–7 years in substation project management), Project/Site Manager approval from DEWA, TAQA, TRANSCO, ETIHADWE, FEWA, AADC, ADDC, or SEWA, and immediate to 30-day availability.

title: Construction Quality Manager (Renewable Energy)
description: Hands-on Construction Quality Manager in Ireland (hybrid, 3–4 days/week on site across Ireland; Irish or EU citizens only). Oversee QA/QC across EPC construction sites from construction through handover. Requires 3+ years QA/QC experience in EPC projects (renewable energy / solar PV desirable), strong knowledge of construction quality standards, inspections, ITPs, NCR management, and an Engineering or Construction Management degree.

title: Client Engagement Manager
description: Client Engagement Manager in Pune (Hybrid, 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM shift) with 6+ years of experience as an Account Manager exclusively within IT services companies, focusing on client relationship management, customer success, account growth, and stakeholder management.

title: Data Engineer & AI Platforms Solutions Specialist
description: Permanent roles in the UAE (UAE-based candidates prioritized): (1) Data Engineer (5–8 years) with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows), Azure (ADLS Gen2, Data Factory, Key Vault), Python, SQL, data governance, PII controls, IaC, and CI/CD; (2) AI Platforms & Solutions Specialist (10+ years in data/ML/software engineering, 2+ years production GenAI/agentic AI) with Databricks Mosaic AI, Vector Search, Azure AI Foundry, LLMs, RAG, MCP tool use, and AI governance.

title: Electrical Engineer (LV & MV)
description: Electrical Engineer for an Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) project in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia (immediate joiners preferred). Requires Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Saudi Arabia, strong hands-on expertise in Low Voltage (LV) and Medium Voltage (MV) systems, preventive/corrective maintenance, electrical panels, transformers, switchgear, and site operations.

title: Service Delivery Manager (SDM)
description: Contract Service Delivery Manager in Essen, Germany (hybrid, 2–3 days/week onsite; must be based in Germany). Requires 12+ years of Service Delivery experience, fluency in German and English, experience managing SAP (ECC, S/4HANA) and Salesforce application support/enhancements, SLA management, ITIL, ServiceNow working knowledge, and onsite/offshore team leadership.

title: Agile Project Manager / Scrum Master
description: W2 Contract Agile Project Manager / Scrum Master in Hoboken, NJ (local candidates only, hybrid). Requires expertise in Agile project management, IT project delivery, Scrum and SAFe methodologies, sprint management, Agile team coaching, product backlog management/prioritization, risk management, and cross-functional stakeholder collaboration.

title: Senior Cyber Security Architect
description: Long-term contract Senior Cyber Security Architect in Qatar with 10+ years of experience in enterprise security architecture within Banking/Financial Services or regulated environments. Core skills: hybrid & multi-cloud security, Zero Trust, IAM/PAM, application & API security, threat modelling, cryptography/key management, network security, and AI/ML security. Mandatory CISSP or CISM certification; Arabic is an advantage.

title: Head of Venue Technology Delivery
description: Lead large-scale ICT and AV/ELV delivery for sports venues, smart stadiums, and major events in Doha, Qatar. Requires 10+ years in IT, 7+ years in a similar leadership role, at least 4 years in sports venue technology, and mandatory PMP or PRINCE2 certification.

title: Chief Financial Officer / Chief Operating Officer (CFO/COO)
description: Senior C-level leader (CFO/COO) for a growing services business in Dubai (Budget up to AED 70,000/month). Requires 17+ years of finance experience, minimum 5 years in C-level roles, M&A experience, financial reporting, strong technology/automation expertise, and current residence in the UAE.

title: Business Analyst – Airline Domain
description: Onsite Business Analyst in Calgary, Canada with strong domain expertise in the Airline and Aviation sector to support enterprise business requirements, process analysis, and project delivery.

title: Planner (SPIR) – Oil & Gas Turnaround
description: Urgent Qatar local hiring for an experienced SPIR Planner for a Turnaround (TA) planning assignment in the Oil & Gas / Petrochemical sector. Requires minimum Diploma, 6–8 years overall experience, at least 5 years in petrochemical/O&G turnaround planning, proficiency in MS Project/Primavera, mandatory SAP PM module experience, and English fluency.

title: Group Procurement Manager
description: Group Procurement Manager for an established construction and contracting group in Abu Dhabi, UAE. Requires 15+ years of overall procurement experience (preferably in the UAE), strong construction/contracting industry background, current senior procurement management experience, group-level strategic sourcing, vendor management, subcontractor negotiations, and current UAE residency.

title: AEM Content Lead
description: Onsite AEM Content Lead in Calgary, Canada experienced in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) content authoring, digital asset governance, content strategy, and enterprise web publishing workflows.

title: Senior AI & Computer Vision Engineer
description: 12-month onsite contract in Abu Dhabi, UAE for autonomous systems projects. Requires strong expertise in Computer Vision, Deep Learning, CNNs, Vision Transformers, Python, C++, PyTorch/TensorFlow, image processing, and visual localization (UAV, infrared imaging, or embedded AI experience is an advantage).

title: Senior SAR Systems Engineer
description: Permanent onsite role in Abu Dhabi, UAE. Requires 5+ years of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) system design and performance engineering, deep knowledge of SAR imaging modes, resolution, swath width, radar performance modelling, SAR architecture, RF systems, and signal processing (satellite payload integration/testing preferred).

title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer – Multi-Robot Systems & Simulation
description: Permanent onsite role in Abu Dhabi, UAE. Requires strong expertise in ROS2, C++, Python, Multi-Robot Systems (MRS), robotics simulation (Gazebo or similar), Sim-to-Real development, multi-robot coordination, distributed autonomy, and deploying robotic software onto physical hardware.

title: Senior Manager – Applications Engineering (Data Centre Power)
description: Global critical power business hiring a Senior Manager of Applications Engineering in Cluj-Napoca, Romania to lead a team of 10–15 Application Engineers and drive technical quality, productivity, and engineering process improvements across international data center operations. Requires engineering leadership background in critical power, UPS, switchgear, or power distribution.

title: IBM ECM Subject Matter Expert (SME)
description: Remote contract IBM ECM SME in India with strong expertise in IBM FileNet P8, IBM Content Manager OnDemand (CMOD), and IBM Content Manager v8 (CM8), responsible for supporting, administering, and enhancing document management, workflow, archiving, records management, and content migration solutions.

title: PostgreSQL Database Administrator
description: Database Administrator role for Saudi Nationals or native Arabic speakers with hands-on PostgreSQL administration, database replication, backup/recovery, and High Availability (HA) architecture experience.

title: MEG Operator (Oil & Gas)
description: MEG Operator in Qatar for Oil & Gas / Petroleum operations. Requires B.Tech/B.E. or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with 3–10 years of experience in MEG operations, DCS, P&ID, plant operations, and Nitrogen & Instrument Air packages.

title: Validation Engineering Manager (Semiconductor)
description: Permanent Validation Engineering Manager leading a 30+ person semiconductor engineering team in Edinburgh, UK (global search with visa sponsorship and relocation support, plus RSUs and discretionary bonus). Requires hands-on silicon validation and characterization experience, mixed-signal background (audio/power analysis valued), technical or team leadership experience, debugging skills, and Python-based test automation.
